zh: 宝宝哭了一整夜。
en: The baby {cried} all night.

zh: 我爸爸在中国长大。
en: My dad {grew} up in China.

zh: 孩子们在花园里玩。
en: The kids are {playing} in the garden.

zh: 他昨晚向她求婚了。
en: He {proposed} to her last night.

zh: 我给宝宝换了尿布。
en: I {changed} the baby's nappy.

zh: 我每天送孩子上学。
en: I {take|drive|walk} the kids to school every day.

zh: 我们女儿明年开始上学。
en: Our daughter {starts} school next year.

zh: 我们家每年圣诞节都团聚。
en: Our family {gets} together every Christmas.

zh: 他们去年结婚了。
en: They {got} married last year.

zh: 宝宝今天迈出了第一步。
en: The baby {took} her first steps today.

zh: 我们给儿子报了游泳课。
en: We {enrolled} our son in swimming lessons.

zh: 我们从 SPCA 领养了一只小狗。
en: We {adopted|got} a puppy from the SPCA.

zh: 宝宝终于安静下来睡着了。
en: The baby finally {settled}.

zh: 我儿子掉了第一颗牙。
en: My son {lost} his first tooth.

zh: 他教会了我骑自行车。
en: He {taught} me to ride a bike.

zh: 她很宠孙子孙女。
en: She {spoils} her grandchildren.

zh: 她一个人把三个孩子养大。
en: She {raised|brought up} three kids on her own.

zh: 他还在依赖父母。
en: He still {depends|relies} on his parents.

zh: 我们给她取名叫 Lily。
en: We {named|called} her Lily.

zh: 我照看了侄子一下午。
en: I {babysat|minded|watched|looked after} my nephew all afternoon.

zh: 我父母下个月来看我们。
en: My parents are {visiting} us next month.

zh: 她长得像她爸爸。
en: She {looks} like her dad.

zh: 我昨晚给女儿读了一个故事。
en: I {read} my daughter a story last night.

zh: 他因为儿子撒谎惩罚了他。
en: He {punished} his son for lying.

zh: 他每天晚上哄孩子睡觉。
en: He {puts} the kids to bed every night.

zh: 我妈妈总是唠叨让我多吃点。
en: My mum always {nags} me to eat more.

zh: 他们去年离婚了。
en: They {got divorced|divorced|split up|separated} last year.

zh: 我妈妈做饭很好吃。
en: My mum {cooks} really well.

zh: 宝宝在长牙。
en: The baby is {teething}.

zh: 我爷爷去年去世了。
en: My grandad {passed away|died} last year.

zh: 我们的狗老是在沙发上掉毛。
en: Our dog keeps {shedding|losing} hair on the couch.

zh: 我兄弟们小时候常在地上摔跤。
en: My brothers used to {wrestle} on the floor.

zh: 她给孩子们掖好被子，让他们睡觉。
en: She {tucked} the kids into bed.

zh: 我得给狗剪指甲了。
en: I need to {clip|trim|cut} the dog's nails.

zh: 他拍了拍狗的头。
en: He {patted} the dog on the head.

zh: 女孩们在后座一直咯咯地笑。
en: The girls kept {giggling} in the back seat.

zh: 狗从篱笆的一个洞里逃了出去。
en: The dog {escaped|got out} through a hole in the fence.

zh: 孩子们喜欢坐着纸板从山坡上滑下来。
en: The kids love {sliding} down the hill on cardboard.

zh: 我们今晚要装饰圣诞树。
en: We're {decorating|doing} the Christmas tree tonight.

zh: 孩子们表现好，我们就奖励他们贴纸。
en: We {reward} the kids with stickers when they behave.

zh: 全家人仍在为奶奶的去世而悲伤。
en: The whole family is still {mourning|grieving} Grandma's death.

zh: 孩子们躲在了沙发后面。
en: The kids {hid} behind the couch.

zh: 现在很多父母不太知道该怎么管教孩子。
en: A lot of parents these days don't know how to {discipline} their kids.

zh: 她轻轻摇着宝宝，哄他睡着了。
en: She {rocked} the baby to sleep.

zh: 轻轻拍宝宝的背，让她打个嗝。
en: Gently pat the baby's back to {burp|wind} her.

zh: 宝宝在长牙，所以一直流口水。
en: The baby is {drooling} a lot because she's teething.

zh: 我每天晚上给宝宝洗澡。
en: I {bathe|bath|wash} the baby every evening.

zh: 宝宝在我怀里一直扭来扭去。
en: The baby keeps {wriggling|squirming} in my arms.

zh: 我姐姐三月份要生第一个孩子。
en: My sister is {expecting} her first baby in March.

zh: 孩子吃完饭问：“我可以下桌了吗？”
en: "Can I be {excused}?" asked my son after dinner.

zh: 我们在临时寄养一只救助狗，直到它找到新主人。
en: We're {fostering} a rescue dog until he finds a home.

zh: 你摸它的时候，猫会发出呼噜声。
en: The cat {purrs} when you stroke her.

zh: 她出门前亲了亲孩子们。
en: She {kissed} the kids before she left.

zh: 她长得很像她爸爸。
en: She {resembles|looks like|takes after} her dad.

zh: 我妈不赞成我辞职去旅行。
en: My mum {disapproves} of me quitting my job to travel.

zh: 宝宝在睡午觉，小声点。
en: The baby's {napping|sleeping}, so keep it down.

zh: 和其他小朋友互动对孩子有好处。
en: It's good for kids to {interact|play|socialise|socialize} with other children.

zh: 洗澡前帮孩子们把衣服脱了。
en: Help the kids {undress} before their bath.

zh: 我婆婆老是干涉我们的决定。
en: My mother-in-law keeps {interfering|meddling} in our decisions.

zh: 气球砰的一声爆了。
en: The balloon {popped|burst} with a loud bang.

zh: 我们正在给宝宝断奶。
en: We're {weaning} the baby at the moment.

zh: 小丑逗孩子们玩了整整一个小时。
en: The clown {amused|entertained} the kids for a whole hour.

zh: 别挠我痒痒！
en: Stop {tickling} me!

zh: 他打破了窗户，被妈妈骂了一顿。
en: His mum {scolded} him for breaking the window.

zh: 我父母二十年前从中国移民到了新西兰。
en: My parents {emigrated|migrated} from China to New Zealand twenty years ago.

zh: 宝宝今天早上五点就把我吵醒了。
en: The baby {woke} me at five this morning.

zh: 那个小孩紧紧抱着妈妈的腿不放。
en: The toddler was {clinging|holding on|hanging on} to her mum's leg.

zh: 我女儿特别喜欢她的新小狗。
en: My daughter {adores|loves} her new puppy.

zh: 狗冲着邮递员低声吼叫。
en: The dog {growled} at the postie.

zh: 周六晚上你能帮我们看一下孩子吗？
en: Could you {babysit|mind|watch|look after} the kids on Saturday night?

zh: 我们正在训练儿子自己上厕所。
en: We're {potty-training|toilet-training} our son.

zh: 你们在奶奶家要乖一点。
en: {Behave} yourselves at Grandma's.

zh: 她还在给宝宝喂母乳。
en: She's still {breastfeeding|nursing|feeding} the baby.

zh: 孩子们在公园里荡秋千。
en: The kids are {swinging} on the swings at the park.

zh: 我们把猫埋在了后院。
en: We {buried} the cat in the back garden.

zh: 孩子们很喜欢抱着猫。
en: The kids love {cuddling|hugging} the cat.

zh: 照顾新生儿让我累得筋疲力尽。
en: Looking after a newborn completely {exhausted|drained} me.

zh: 孩子扯了扯我的袖子。
en: The little boy {tugged|pulled} at my sleeve.

zh: 孩子们迫不及待地拆开了礼物。
en: The kids couldn't wait and {unwrapped|opened} their presents.

zh: 狗舔了舔我的脸。
en: The dog {licked} my face.

zh: 她每天晚上睡前都祈祷。
en: She {prays} every night before bed.

zh: 学校正在为建新的游乐场筹款。
en: The school is {fundraising} for a new playground.

zh: 下雨天很难让孩子们有事可做、不无聊。
en: It's hard to {entertain|amuse|occupy} the kids on rainy days.

zh: 他们让三个孩子都在家上学。
en: They {homeschool|home-school} all three of their kids.

zh: 宝宝开始会爬了。
en: The baby has started {crawling}.

zh: 别再哼哼唧唧地发牢骚了！
en: Stop {whining|moaning|whingeing|whinging|complaining}!

zh: 宝宝在吸吮大拇指。
en: The baby is {sucking} her thumb.

zh: 奶奶总是偏爱我哥哥。
en: Grandma always {favoured|favored} my brother.

zh: 孩子们求我给他们买冰淇淋。
en: The kids {begged|pleaded with|asked} me to buy them ice cream.

zh: 你能去卧室帮我把眼镜拿过来吗？
en: Can you {fetch|get|grab|bring} my glasses from the bedroom?

zh: 孩子们老是吵架。
en: The kids are always {quarrelling|quarreling|arguing|fighting|bickering}.

zh: 她把一生都献给了孩子们。
en: She {devoted|dedicated|gave} her life to her kids.
